ed.chat.qa.book.q._en: How do I book a free session?

ed.chat.qa.book.a._en: Book a free session and we look at how your work really happens. You leave with a written plan and an hours estimate, yours to keep. There is no cost and no jargon.

ed.chat.qa.book.also._en: book, booking, appointment, meeting, consultation, call, free session, walkthrough, get started, talk to someone

ed.chat.qa.what.a._en: Two ways we help. Automations that clear the repetitive work: quotes and invoices, customer replies, bookings and reminders, moving data between apps, your numbers every week, and records you can show. And digital tools built around your business: websites that win trust, staff and customer portals, and live dashboards.

ed.chat.qa.what.also._en: what do you do, services, what can you help with, what do you offer, automate, automation ideas, examples

ed.chat.qa.time.a._en: We start with one automation, usually built in one to two weeks depending on the job. You see it run on your real jobs, checked alongside the way you do it now, before it goes live.

ed.chat.qa.time.also._en: how long, timeline, how quickly, how soon, weeks, turnaround, when will it be ready

ed.chat.qa.how.a._en: Three steps. We watch the work and leave you with a written plan and an hours estimate, yours to keep. We build one automation first, usually in one to two weeks, and you see it run on your real jobs. Then you own it: we hand over the logins, train your team, and fix or tweak anything free for the first 30 days.

ed.chat.qa.app.q._en: Do you build apps or portals?

ed.chat.qa.app.a._en: Yes: staff and customer portals. Job tracking, photos, invoices and approvals in your own app on every phone. Each person sees only what they need, with your logo and colours and a secure sign-in, and it installs on the home screen like a normal app.

ed.chat.qa.free.a._en: We sit with whoever actually does the job and look at how the work really happens today. You leave with a written plan and an hours estimate, yours to keep even if you don't hire us. There is no cost and no jargon, and it can happen on site or remotely.

ed.chat.qa.tools.q._en: Which software do you work with?

ed.chat.qa.tools.a._en: Most automations connect the tools you already pay for: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint), Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Sheets and Drive) and Xero. Where your booking, point-of-sale or job software can export to Excel or Google Sheets, or sends you emails, we work from that. Most of the time you won't need new software.
